answers.how: The boat moves about 450 pixels in 8.167 seconds, giving 55.1 px/s. At 2 m/s, its approximately 100-pixel length is 3.63 m.
Using the motion-derived scale of 2/55.1 meters per pixel, the boat's approximately 35-pixel width is 1.27 m.
The bridge is approximately 190 pixels wide across the canal's direction. Using 2/55.1 meters per pixel gives 6.9 m.
